result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks in good condition on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, visibility is compromised by vehicles parked close to the crossing, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible.

hazards.name: Parking near crosswalk
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the image are very close to the crosswalk, obstructing the view between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information to people crossing.
